summary: Risk plan prioritizes server-only OpenRouter proxying, mocked provider failure coverage, streaming persistence semantics, backend/frontend schema alignment, and final secret/generated artifact gates. No material ambiguity blocks implementation planning.

proposals.title: Lock server-side provider boundary first
proposals.summary: Implement OpenRouter access only inside backend provider modules with a mockable trait, explicit error mapping, timeout handling, and no frontend exposure of provider URLs or keys.

proposals.title: Prove streaming persistence semantics with tests
proposals.summary: Cover successful SSE delta forwarding and interrupted-stream behavior before wiring the frontend, ensuring incomplete assistant messages are never persisted.

proposals.title: Keep frontend contracts validated at the API edge
proposals.summary: Centralize zod schemas for backend response parsing and treat malformed JSON or malformed SSE events as visible app errors instead of silent UI corruption.

proposals.title: Mock all networked test paths
proposals.summary: Use backend provider mocks and Playwright route interception so automated tests never consume OpenRouter quota or require local secrets.

proposals.title: Add a final hygiene gate
proposals.summary: Verify placeholder-only env examples, ignored local env files, no tracked databases or build output, and no OpenRouter key patterns before final reporting.

risks.title: Provider key or OpenRouter endpoint leaks into frontend
risks.impact: A browser-visible key or direct provider call would violate the server-side proxy requirement and expose local secrets.
risks.mitigation: Keep only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL in frontend, grep tracked files for OpenRouter key patterns, and add Playwright assertions that no browser request targets OpenRouter.

risks.title: Streaming failure persists partial assistant output
risks.impact: Interrupted streams could leave misleading or corrupt assistant messages in SQLite while the UI reports an error.
risks.mitigation: Accumulate assistant text outside persistence, insert assistant only after stream completion, and test interrupted stream paths with a mock provider.

risks.title: Automated tests call real OpenRouter
risks.impact: Tests would be flaky, require secrets, consume quota, and violate the project rule forbidding external provider calls from automated tests.
risks.mitigation: Use dependency-injected provider mocks in Rust tests and Playwright network interception for frontend smoke coverage.

risks.title: Backend and frontend response contracts drift
risks.impact: The UI may break on valid backend errors or silently accept malformed data, especially around SSE events and structured JSON errors.
risks.mitigation: Define DTOs clearly in backend tests, mirror response expectations in frontend zod schemas, and include malformed response tests.

risks.title: SQLite usage blocks provider calls or races updates
risks.impact: Holding transactions while waiting on provider responses can lock local SQLite state and cause poor behavior under concurrent requests.
risks.mitigation: Persist user message, release DB work before provider call, then persist assistant after provider success; test conversation updated_at ordering.

risks.title: Markdown rendering introduces unsafe raw HTML behavior
risks.impact: Assistant content could render executable or misleading markup in the browser.
risks.mitigation: Use react-markdown without rehype-raw, add tests for raw script or HTML content, and render code/GFM through safe components only.

risks.title: CORS is either too open or breaks local frontend development
risks.impact: Overly broad CORS weakens the proxy boundary, while overly narrow CORS prevents the Next.js app from calling the backend.
risks.mitigation: Make frontend origin configurable, default to the documented local origin, and test allowed origin behavior.

risks.title: Generated artifacts are accidentally tracked
risks.impact: SQLite databases, build outputs, node_modules, or Playwright reports could pollute the repository and final PR.
risks.mitigation: Update .gitignore early and run git ls-files checks for backend/target, frontend/.next, frontend/node_modules, Playwright reports, and .codedungeon/codedungeon.db.

claims.title: OpenRouter remains backend-only
claims.summary: All provider calls, keys, model defaults, timeouts, and provider error mapping belong in backend modules and must be mocked in tests.

claims.title: Mocked failure coverage is mandatory
claims.summary: Provider 429, timeout, invalid response, missing configuration, streaming success, and interrupted stream paths should be verified without external network calls.

claims.title: Streaming is the highest integration risk
claims.summary: SSE framing, client parsing, provider interruption, and persistence-on-completion semantics cross backend, frontend, and QA ownership.

claims.title: Final reporting depends on verification evidence
claims.summary: Completion claims must wait for backend checks, frontend checks, Playwright smoke, secret scan, generated artifact scan, and CodeDungeon review/finalization gates.
